summary: IHS Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a board change: William Saad, a co-founder and current EVP & Group COO, was appointed executive director effective April 29, 2026, replacing Bashir El-Rufai, who resigned. The filing states no dispute or disagreement prompted the resignation, and the company thanked the outgoing director. No specific terms (stake, price) apply. There is no indication this is part of a broader strategic contest or activist campaign. The change appears orderly and routine. The event is a director addition and resignation, not an abrupt or contested departure. The non-US (London) filing is treated as a current report equivalent.
